title: Revealing Hidden Bias in AI: Lessons from Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using Claude 3.5 Sonnet as an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate and score generated candidate interview reports on a 0-2 scale, comparing outputs from standard versus anonymized CVs. Also evaluated using Hugging Face sequence classification models.
